Basics of Alchemy
Alchemy Overview
Alchemy
is a crafting skill that is easy to learn, difficult to master.
Mycology
is tangentially related, but many Alchemists refuse to accept it as such. Alchemists often mix potions, lotions, ointments, and oils. Some Alchemists have been known to use their skills to create poisoned weapons, or specific potions to resist the elements.
In-Game Description
The art of combining esoteric things together to make potions and poisons.
Training Alchemy
The
Alchemy
skill is learned by doing anything to gain experience in Alchemy.  Unlike some other skills, you do not need to first learn the skill in order to gain experience in Alchemy.  There are several ways to first gain XP in Alchemy:
Learn level 0 Alchemy recipes, and use them.
The book
Basics of Alchemy
, which can be found in
Elmetaph
's bookcase in the lighthouse on
Anagoge Island
, teaches two level 0 Alchemy recipes.  (
Basics of Alchemy
can also be found on the first level of the
Anagoge Records Facility
on
Anagoge Island
.)
The book
Alchemy: So You Want To Be An Alchemist
is sold by
Yetta
in
Eltibule Keep
and contains a level 0 Alchemy recipe.
The book
Alchemy: Safe Brain Boosts For Beginners
is a random drop from various mobs, and contains a level 0 Alchemy recipe.  It can often be found on the
Buy Used
tab at vendors such as
Hulon
,
Velkort
or
Fainor
.
Marna
will teach
Poison Resistance Potion
, a level 0 Alchemy recipe, if you gain favor with her.
Therese
will teach
Recipe: Bone Meal (From Any Bone)
and
Recipe: Bone Meal (From Humanoid Skull)
(both level 0 Alchemy recipes) if you gain favor with her.
Once a level 0 recipe is learned, use that recipe to gain Alchemy XP and the
Alchemy
skill. Repeat the recipe, and/or use additional recipes to gain more experience (first use of any recipe gives an XP bonus), and increase your skill level.  As your skill level increases, greater experience gains may be achieved by continuing to learn additional recipes from various books (see below).
Earn Alchemy experience by doing favors
Marna
will give Alchemy XP if you complete
Lapis Lazuli for Marna
.
Earn Alchemy experience by doing hang-outs
Rita
will give Alchemy XP if you complete
Help Rita Make Soap
.
Alchemy on
Anagoge
Alchemy
can be learned on
Anagoge Island
without ever leaving the island.  Learn the recipes in
Basics of Alchemy
as described above.  These recipes allow for the creation of
Parasol Mushroom Flakes
. The flakes are a necessary ingredient for
Pick-Me-Up Juice
.  Creating
Pick-Me-Up Juice
gains skill in Alchemy, and you may find the juice is needed by a certain individual on the island.
Alchemy NPCs
Azalak
is a friendly Mantis in north
Serbule
who can teach you some Alchemy recipes if you earn his trust.
Marna
in
Serbule
will teach an Alchemy recipe if you gain favor with her.
Therese

Serbule

Yetta
in
Eltibule
will offer several Alchemy skills to those that gain favor with her.
Jaw
in the
Myconian Cave
teaches a few Alchemy recipes.
Zealo
in
Carpal Tunnels
teaches several Alchemy recipes.
Yagreet
in
Sun Vale
teaches several Alchemy recipes. Teaches higher level Mushroom Suspension recipes.
Ragabir
in
Red Wing Casino
teaches a lot of level 40 Alchemy recipes.
Charles Thompson

Serbule

Serbule Keep
. He has been known to teach some of his
Mycology
recipes to those who gain his trust.

lists: The bookBasics of Alchemy, which can be found inElmetaph's bookcase in the lighthouse onAnagoge Island, teaches two level 0 Alchemy recipes.  (Basics of Alchemycan also be found on the first level of theAnagoge Records FacilityonAnagoge Island.)
The bookAlchemy: So You Want To Be An Alchemistis sold byYettainEltibule Keepand contains a level 0 Alchemy recipe.

The bookAlchemy: Safe Brain Boosts For Beginnersis a random drop from various mobs, and contains a level 0 Alchemy recipe.  It can often be found on theBuy Usedtab at vendors such asHulon,VelkortorFainor.
Marnawill teachPoison Resistance Potion, a level 0 Alchemy recipe, if you gain favor with her.
Theresewill teachRecipe: Bone Meal (From Any Bone)andRecipe: Bone Meal (From Humanoid Skull)(both level 0 Alchemy recipes) if you gain favor with her.
Marnawill give Alchemy XP if you completeLapis Lazuli for Marna.
Ritawill give Alchemy XP if you completeHelp Rita Make Soap.
Mycology- A skill which produces some mixtures used in Alchemy.
Battle Chemistry- Battle Chemistry requires Level 50 Alchemy.
Gardening- Alchemy can be used to createBone MealandRotten Meat, which can be components ofBottle of Fertilizer.
Alchemy was one of the skills players learned in the old Tutorial Cave, beforeAnagogewas added to the game.
